interpretation: Woodward contrasts causal efficacy with common-cause and selection correlations and defines total causation through change under intervention. Valid interventions break incoming causal dependence and exclude independent routes to the outcome. Our deterministic binary response-table test specializes that criterion but is not a formalization of all (IV) conditions or probabilistic causation.
